name: ClientBlockQcRound
meaning: QC round of the block differs from the previous round: QC round, expected

name: ClientBlockQcHash
meaning: QC hash of the block differs from the digest of the previous block: QC hash, expected

name: ClientBlockTx
meaning: digest of the tx bytes differs from the row hash: row hash

name: ClientBlockTxHashes
meaning: tx rows differ from the block hash vector in count or at one index

name: ClientBlockTime
meaning: 12 byte row time differs from block +0x90

name: ClientBlockUnexpectedCommitProof
meaning: proof on a block that is not last; the flush rule makes this unreachable from 0x4360000

name: ClientBlockMissingCommitProof
meaning: last block has no proof; the flush rule makes this unreachable from 0x4360000

name: ClientBlockMissingTx
meaning: a block hash is not in the local tx map: hash

name: CommitProofChildQc
meaning: QC hash in the child differs from the digest of the last block

name: CommitProofGrandchildQc
meaning: hash of the second QC differs from the digest of the child

name: CommitProofConsecutive
meaning: child round differs from last round + 1, saturating
